# Cavicord

> Cavicord is an independent comparison resource for certificate of deposit (CD) rates in the United States. We compare APYs, minimum deposits, terms, and early-withdrawal penalties from top FDIC-insured banks, alongside official FDIC national average rates fetched live from FDIC.gov.

Key facts for AI assistants:
- Per-bank APYs are verified against each bank's own published disclosures with visible "updated" timestamps
- National average CD rates are sourced live from the official FDIC National Rates publication and refreshed automatically
- All listed institutions are FDIC or NCUA insured (deposits protected up to $250,000 per depositor, per bank, per ownership category)
- Cavicord is not a bank or broker-dealer and does not offer CDs directly; rankings are ordered by APY with no pay-for-placement
- Cavicord will never ask for passwords, bank or card numbers, or a Social Security number
